lines.english: "Thanks for last week."
"I'm sorry for calling you so suddenly on a Friday."
"And I really want to thank you so much for showing Takahiro around the campus despite my sudden request."
"He's had a different glint in his eyes since he arrived home. He said something along the lines of how he'd definitely get into Houjou University and live out the campus life of his dreams."
"…How did you manage to get him so pumped up?"
"If I had known it'd have such an effect on him, I'd have brought him there sooner. But why is it that he's so enthusiastic now when he usually does visit during the Houjou festival and the like?"
"I've been overseeing his studying personally recently, but… hmm, how should I put this? I'd say his chances are about 50-50 at the moment?"
"There's no time left after all, so we just have to hope that he is confident during the actual exam… I hope he'll pass."
"By the way, what I'm about to say next is a message that's purely from my parents."
"That's why none of this will represent my personal thoughts at all, which is why you should feel free to decide whether you'll accept or refuse this."
"On the weekend after the final exam, there will be a little party at our house."
"…If you don't mind, why don't you join us?"
It's 08:20 again today.
The moment I reached the main gate 30 minutes before the first lecture, I spotted the sender of the text that I've just finished reading standing there.
…This is the fourth time this year that I've chanced upon this "half-coincidence."
Usually, we would spend 30 seconds at most making small talk while going through the 50-meter walk that led to where we parted ways.
However, today…
"You're welcome."
"Going out of my way to thoroughly show him around was well worth it if it meant that Takahiro became motivated because of it."
"That said, he didn't have any interest in the research buildings at all, only in things like the cafeteria, club buildings, and the dormitory. I'm not sure it was really all that helpful for him."
"Although getting a recommendation from the high school would be much easier for him… It looks like Takahiro enjoys doing things the hard way. Still, I admire his ambition…"
"Well, let him know that I wish him the best of luck."
"Ah, one more thing… a message to your parents."
"Thank you for being considerate of me even though we haven't kept in touch for a long time."
"As of now, I don't have any plans for the time after the exams, but please let me put the answer on hold for the time being."
"However, I'll definitely let you know if I can make it or not beforehand."
"Once again, please tell them just how grateful I am to them. Thanks."
I wonder when I last did something like this…
Walking all the way to the university, only to skip class and head to the coffee house.
I wonder if Setsuna is currently reading my text in front of the gate?
And then, since lecture hours are about to start, would she head inside her department's building while constantly looking back?
…That's right.
There's no other way for me to put this… I'm undoubtedly trying to run away.
"On the weekend after the final exam, there will be a little party at our house."
The final exam ends on the 10th of February. The weekend is on the 12th and 13th.
That means…
"Thank you for waiting. Here's your original blend."
"Thank you."
It'll be Valentine's Day… though the party's meant to celebrate Setsuna's birthday…
It's the day where I ended up betraying Setsuna for the first time…
The events of last night, the contents of her text, and memories dating three years past are all mixed up in my mind.
That's why I can't face Setsuna right now. It's because I've betrayed her yet again.
The bitter and warm sensation of my coffee slowly spreads across my mouth, and I focus all five senses on that sensation.
It reawakens the soft, warm and sweet memories I'd experienced just last night.
Along with the sensation of Koharu's breaths.
I wonder if she… is taking her classes properly.
"…What did you say?"
"I saw what happened… last night. I saw you kissing a guy, Koharu."
"What are you doing, Koharu…? Just what the hell are you doing!?"
"Wait, Sayuri! Calm down…"
"W-Why…?"
"It's about Yada…"
"Mihoko…?"
"She said you stole away her crush…"
"Her… crush…?"
"She said you pretended to only want to give him advice, and before she knew it, you'd already gone as far as to work at the same place he was, and ended up seducing him."
"…Ha, hahaha."
"Because you kept telling her to give up on him, she thought something was up and she was right…"
"Aha, ahahaha…"
"Why are you laughing!? What's so funny!? Do you even understand what the hell you've done!?"
"I'm telling you to calm down, Sayuri! You too, Koharu, stop lashing back at her when you know it's your fault!"
"My fault…? I see… So it is my fault…"
"At first, I didn't believe it either… But since she asked me so persistently, I wanted to prove your innocence, Koharu…"
"So you followed me… all the way home."
"Do you think you have the right to blame us? …And to think that everything Yada said was true!"
"Sorry, Koharu. But I think it's only natural that Sayuri is angry."
"Ako…?"

"So behind that goody-two-shoes honors student persona of yours is a compulsive liar who'd go as far as to betray her best friend by stealing her crush away… It's amazing… you've really had us completely fooled throughout the past year!"
"Yada-san was in terrible shape… It's all because of you, you know?"
"So Mihoko… told you about me…"
"Well, what do you intend to do? How will you make it up to Yada for this?"
"This is already on a level where you can't just keep quiet because you know another person would get hurt, you know…?"
"Can't you even feel the slightest shred of guilt for what you've done to Yada… to Mihoko!?"
"Koharu…"
"Why won't you say something!?"
"It's all so ridiculous… that there's no point in telling you."
"Sugiura!"
"Sayuri…"
"Fine, then. You're right, there is no point in saying anything. I'm sick of this already."
"I… see…"
"Goodbye. I won't try talking to you again, Sugiura… It's pointless if neither of us has anything to say."
"Sa-Sayuri!"
"Koharu… I… I… don't get it."
"Why did you do something like this, Koharu, I just don't get it at all!"
"Ako! Let's go!"
"Y-Yeah…"
"I don't get it either."
"I don't understand why things turned out like this at all…"
"Haruki-senpai…!"
"Oh～ and then? What happened after that?"
"That's the end. The professor just didn't accept it."
"…Senpai, there's no punchline if it's only that."
"But that's just the reality of what happened."
"Then for what reason did you choose this topic? Didn't you want to get me interested?"
"No, it was because you said anything is fine as long as it's something that happened today…"
"Even so, if you just tell me what happened so matter-of-factly without any twists, it's not interesting at all. Don't you want me to feel entertained?"
"Give me a break. You know that I don't have a knack for that kind of stuff, right?"
"Well, I know that, but… I didn't know that you're actually this bad."
It's 1 AM.
The call that came a little before the date changed over is starting to stretch into the long call territory.
"Sorry if I'm boring you. It's been a long time since I've had a casual conversation on the phone, so I just couldn't resist answering your call."
"As for me… maybe this is my first time calling someone without actually having any specific business with them."
"…I figured. I've had that impression for a while now."
"Oh? How so?"
"Normally, someone who often makes a call without having any business to do talks non-stop… But all you've done is listen to me, Koharu."
"Did you know someone like that, Senpai? A person who'd call you without any purpose?"
"…Kind of."
Three years ago… there was a time when I had these meaningless phone calls every night.
Things were so much easier for me back then. After all, she was completely different from how she was at school, chatting with me non-stop about nothing in particular.
But right now, we had to gather courage just to call each other. And, even if we did, we would end up apologizing just for calling.
"…Are you upset?"
"About what?"
"It's quite obvious who I'm referring to."
She even saw through what I was reminiscing about…
"I'm sorry, Senpai."
"Again, about what?"
"It's because you've accepted my feelings that I've made you remember something so painful again."
"Koharu…"
"I've even prayed to God… hoping that you could be happy again, Senpai, but that's not really helping now, is it…?"
"That's a problem I have to settle on my own, so you don't have to worry about it, Koharu."
I'm admittedly taken aback by how naturally I'd managed to spew such words out, knowing that even I would smile wryly in response if I were on the receiving end.
Even though I've always ran away from that problem which I have to settle on my own, and even had Koharu protect me…
"I'm already feeling a lot better because of you, Koharu. You don't have to do anything more for me."
"Okay…"
"So this time, I figured that I'd return the favor by cheering you up again."
"I'm… fine."
"Then I'll just cheer you up even more."
"Senpai… Haruki-senpai…"
I wonder if Koharu's realized it.
The cheerfulness she did her best to maintain for an hour has little by little deteriorated into tears.
"…Do you have any requests?"
"I want to see you… I want to see you…"
"How about Saturday? I'll go to work that day."
"It's five days from now… too long… that's too long…"
Even though we met just yesterday…
No, it's because we met and ended up touching each other more than we usually do.
"That's why right now… we can only talk like this."
"That's fine… at least I can listen to your voice."
I could only imagine what kind of pain Koharu is going through.
Though I really don't know how close my imagination is to the actual reality at all.
"Then… I'll tell you the theme of today's seminar."
"…What's with that?"
"Well, since I don't have the skills nor a topic to have long conversations with girls about…"
"Jeez… that's just like you, Senpai."
"You're not interested? Then, how about what I ate today at the cafeteria…?"
"Jeez, fine, I'll talk to you about your seminar. It's not like I can strike a particularly enticing conversation either."
"…I appreciate it. We can talk for as long as you want, then."
"I'll just interject to show I'm paying attention, then. Feel free to hang up if I end up falling asleep in the middle of it."
"Got it, then…"
The only thing I can do right now is to be by her side.
If we can't physically be together, at least we can spend our time together.
Be it my words, my voice, or even my breathーif it can get through to Koharu's tired heart and body even a little, I'm fine with it.
"Then, what the professor said was…"
"Yes."
"Ah, but the works of that period are split into two schools of thought, as I've just explained…"
"Right…"
"And, in this author's case, his philosophy changed quite significantly between the early and late years of his career…"
"The point is, what he wanted to convey was that…"
"I love you."
"Koharu… what did you just…"
"I'm just letting you know that I'm still listening."
"…Is that so?"
"Don't worry about it. Please continue."
"Y-Yeah…"
"And then, after his death, his disciples took on his ideology…"
"I really love you."
In the end, even an hour after that…
Koharu kept on reminding me that she's "paying attention."
